column1: # Tag audit proposals — tranche 3: every 8th flag by code at offset 2 (32 of 254).
# Additions and aliases; removals are their own round. Afghanistan is left out on
# purpose: its image and its data describe two different flags. See #174.
# HOW TO REVIEW: delete the rows you disagree with. What survives is applied.
# Nothing else to fill in; the deletions are themselves the record of your call.
# The pull request shows each flag's image beside its row.
# Then say so, and the agent runs scripts/apply-tag-audit.mjs, the validators and
# the Playwright suite. Do not edit proposals.original.tsv — the difference
# between it and this file is how your rejections get remembered.
# Read the name; the code beside it is what the script applies to, and a row whose
# name and code disagree is refused. To see a flag: https://flagfilter.com/?q=<name>
# Columns: name, code, tag or alias, add|remove|alias, confidence, why.

column6: A trident is a fishing spear as well as a weapon; the owner judged that the axe rule covers it.
The eagle holds a fue, a fly-whisk, beside the war club, as the flag's own symbolism says.
The red lion holds a shield showing the wreck of the Sea Venture.
An olive branch stands inside an olive wreath.
A sun rises behind the canoe, its orange rays above the waves.
The three lions are on a red shield under the crown.
The crescent and the two flowers are on a shield held by the seahorses.
The ribbon reads RA HACHIRI, which the flag's own symbolism calls the Mayotte motto.
The wirebird, the ship and the cliffs are on a shield.
A red crescent wraps the star inside the white disc.
The crane stands on a white disc at the centre.
The eagle is the whole emblem, and eagle is what someone would type.
The emblem is an olive branch; searching olive also matches it.
The emblem is a white flower, the bauhinia.
The emblem is the Star of David; the search reads star as the filter and matches the rest against this alias.
The cedar is the whole emblem.
Two seahorses hold the shield, and they are what the eye goes to.
The emblem shows a rifle with a bayonet, crossed with a hoe.
The rifle and hoe lie on an open book.
The emblem is a grey crowned crane, as the flag's own symbolism says.
The emblem is an outrigger canoe in front of the sun.
The cedar is often taken for a pine; owner decision.
There are two seahorses, so the plural too; owner decision.
